integrity: The symbolic displacement case table and commuting-pair bound prove the all-length result; standalone exhaustive checks validate finite cases only. Novelty is assessed against identified primary literature and closely related mathematical records, not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Exact-two sequential plain palindromic duplications of block length three, source length at least three, alphabet size at least three. Binary sources, other odd block lengths and error-correcting code capacity are not resolved.
title: Sharp two-step length-three palindromic duplication spheres over fixed ternary alphabets
